mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.sort, COUNT(k.id) AS knowledge_count FROM knowledge_category c LEFT JOIN knowledge k ON k.category_id = c.id AND k.status = 1 AND k.deleted = 0 WHERE c.status = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.sort ORDER BY c.sort ASC, c.id ASC

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.sort, c.status, COUNT(k.id) AS knowledge_count, c.create_time, c.update_time FROM knowledge_category c LEFT JOIN knowledge k ON k.category_id = c.id AND k.status = 1 AND k.deleted = 0
c.status = #{status}
AND c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.sort, c.status, c.create_time, c.update_time ORDER BY c.sort ASC, c.id ASC

SELECT c.name, COUNT(k.id) AS `count` FROM knowledge_category c LEFT JOIN knowledge k ON k.category_id = c.id AND k.status = 1 AND k.deleted = 0 WHERE c.status = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY COUNT(k.id) DESC, c.sort ASC, c.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
